newsitem.title: USA: Ringer gets $25 mln, 3-year credit pact.
newsitem.headline: Ringer gets $25 mln, 3-year credit pact.

text.p: Ringer Corp said it has secured a three-year, $25 million credit facility from GE Capital Services to finance the company's seasonal working capital needs estimated to peak at $3 to $5 million and to provide financing for future acquisitions.
This $25 million credit facility replaces a $5 million line of credit from another lender.

Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer Stanley Goldberg, said this financing package "should allow us to aggressively pursue one of our primary strategic objectives, which is to grow the business through acquisitions."
Ringer is expected to benefit from the larger size of the credit facility, from lower interest rates and from greater operating flexibility as a result of less restrictive loan covenants, he said.
Ringer develops, makes and markets lawn and garden care products.
